_comment: The SECOND deliverable. Every સ્વાધ્યાય block inventoried in 01_meta.json is answered here and NOWHERE else — સ્વાધ્યાય is never a teaching topic. subject: Gujarati

Most GSEB readers print no 'સ્વાધ્યાય' banner: the numbered headings below the શબ્દાર્થ box ARE the blocks, re-worded per chapter, so never assume a heading list.
